upg7:1.1: May all creatures, all breathing creatures, all beings,
upg7:1.4: all those who are Noble, all those who are not (yet) Noble,
upg7:1.5: all gods, all human beings, all who have fallen (into the lower worlds),
upg7:1.6: be free from hatred, free from oppression, free from trouble,
upg7:1.7: may they take care of themselves and be happy, may they be free from suffering,
upg7:1.8: being ones who own their actions, may they not lose whatever prosperity they have gained.
upg7:2.1: In the Eastern direction, in the Western direction,
upg7:2.2: in the Northern direction, in the Southern direction,
upg7:2.3: in the South-Eastern direction, in the North-West direction,
upg7:2.4: in the North-East direction, in the South-West direction,
upg7:2.5: in the lower direction, in the upper direction.
upg7:3.1: May all creatures, all breathing creatures, all beings,
upg7:3.4: all those who are Noble, all those who are not (yet) Noble,
upg7:3.5: all gods, all human beings, all who have fallen (into the lower worlds),
upg7:3.6: be free from hatred, free from oppression, free from trouble,
upg7:3.7: may they take care of themselves and be happy, may they be free from suffering,
upg7:3.8: being ones who own their actions, may they not lose whatever prosperity they have gained.
upg7:4.1: From the top of existence down, and from the Avīci hell up,
upg7:4.2: everywhere in the universe, whatever beings live on the earth,
upg7:4.3: (may they be) free from oppression, free from hatred, free from suffering, and free from danger.
upg7:5.1: From the top of existence down, and from the Avīci hell up,
upg7:5.2: everywhere in the universe, whatever beings live in the water,
upg7:5.3: (may they be) free from oppression, free from hatred, free from suffering, and free from danger.
upg7:6.1: From the top of existence down, and from the Avīci hell up,
upg7:6.2: everywhere in the universe, whatever beings live in the sky,
upg7:6.3: (may they be) free from oppression, free from hatred, free from suffering, and free from danger.
upg7:7.1: I have attained what is wholesome, by the power of this, may all beings,
upg7:7.2: having understood the King of the True Dhamma’s Doctrine, be led to happiness,
upg7:7.4: be without grief, without continuing despair, (and attain) the supreme happiness of Emancipation.
upg7:8.1: May the True Dhamma last long, may all beings have respect for the Dhamma,
upg7:8.2: may the (rain)-gods rain down at the right time.
upg7:9.1: Just like the Good Kings of old gave protection, likewise
upg7:9.2: may the (present) King protect the people righteously like (he protects) himself.
upg7:10.1: By this practice in conformity with the Dhamma I worship the Buddha,
upg7:10.2: by this practice in conformity with the Dhamma I worship the Dhamma,
upg7:10.3: by this practice in conformity with the Dhamma I worship the Saṅgha,
upg7:10.4: by this practice may I be freed from birth, old age, sickness and death.
upg7:11.1: May my merit bring about the destruction of the pollutants.
upg7:12.1: May my merit be a condition for (gaining) Emacipation.
upg7:13.1: I share my portion of merits with all beings,
upg7:13.2: may all of them share my portion of merits evenly.
